title: Hackers Use AI Agents and GodPotato Exploit to Gain Windows SYSTEM Privileges
content_md: Hackers used AI agents to turn an exposed application endpoint into full administrative control of a server in under 24 hours. The intrusion involved hundreds of commands, credential theft, and Windows privilege escalation without new malware or a zero-day vulnerability.
